1.w: A song of ascents. From the deep water I cry out to you, O Lord.

2.w: O Lord, listen to me. Pay attention to my plea for mercy.

3.w: If you, O Lord, were to keep track of sins, O Lord, who could stand before you?

4.w: But you are willing to forgive so that you might be honored.

5.w: I rely on the Lord. I rely on him with my whole being; I wait for his assuring word.

6.w: I yearn for the Lord, more than watchmen do for the morning, yes, more than watchmen do for the morning.

7.w: O Israel, hope in the Lord, for the Lord exhibits loyal love and is more than willing to deliver.

8.w: He will deliver Israel from all their sins.
